title: RetiredSpec:ConnectNetwork

_meta.purpose: Retirement tombstone only. The former LinkedIn-class Connect Network product is no longer a standalone microservice or implementation lane.

retirement.reason: The name network was ambiguous with infrastructure networking, while the substantive scope was a LinkedIn-class professional product. Per ADR-0132 single-concern doctrine and the 2026-05-21 directive, that product scope merges into community.

migrated_content: jobs, applications, recruiter stub, and ATS handoff

counterpart_reset.not_counterparts_reason: Those are infrastructure networking benchmarks and belong to cloud-network doctrine, not to community.

forbidden_rehydration: new network standalone OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, proto, Helm, or runbook surface
successor_requirements: Use community professional-profile, professional-graph, inmail-bridge, endorsement-engine, skill-assessments, jobs-recruiter, and pages-events bounded contexts for migrated content.
Use cloud-network for service mesh, NetworkPolicy, DNS, edge proxy, load balancer, VPC-equivalent, and infrastructure networking semantics.
Keep this JSON as provenance until a community machine-readable successor projection absorbs the former network product fields.
